hero.title: Google Lets You Build a Video Game by Typing a Description
hero.description: Google's Playground turns a typed description into a playable, shareable game, no coding required. It's live for U.S. adults, with creation access tiered by Google AI subscription.

latest.description: Finland has emerged as a key location for data centers amid the AI boom.

latest.title: US Government Moves $103 Million in Seized Bitcoin and BNB, But Hasn't Said Why
latest.description: Government-labeled wallets sent 833.6 BTC to Coinbase Prime deposit addresses and shuffled 40,285 BNB. No sale is confirmed, but the stash behind it is the largest any government holds in Arkham's ranking.

latest.title: Modelo owner Constellation is getting creative to bring back beer drinkers as overall demand weakens
latest.description: Constellation Brands beat earnings and revenue expectations as beer brands gained share, while inventory rebuilding and consumer caution clouded demand.

latest.title: Disney+ to stream upcoming Super Bowl
latest.description: Disney+ will also air two Monday Night Football games leading up to the championship game.

latest.title: Apollo, banks in talks to finance SpaceX's $40 billion Nvidia GPU purchase
latest.description: Since SpaceX's record-breaking IPO in June, rates have sold off, and yields on its bonds have risen, along with other AI-related bonds.

latest.title: Polygon taps TRON’s $94 billion stablecoin supply for seamless cross-border transfers
latest.description: Polygon said businesses can also move the world’s largest stablecoin USDT between TRON and EVM networks without connecting to a wallet provider, bridge or fiat-ramp operator.

latest.title: Used car prices fall in Q3, while demand for fuel-efficient vehicles grows
latest.description: Used vehicle prices are forecast to fall more than previously expected this year, according to Cox Automotive.

latest.title: Tether, Kazakhstan cenbank mull tenge stablecoin and asset tokenization
latest.description: The agreement will explore a tenge-backed stablecoin pilot and a framework for tokenizing real-world assets as Kazakhstan expands its digital asset industry.

latest.title: House Finance panel chair says regulator actions on crypto ‘fall short’ of CLARITY bill
latest.description: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient

latest.title: Coinbase brings global crypto derivatives liquidity to US with Deribit integration
latest.description: US institutions will gain access to Deribit’s options and perpetual futures through Coinbase, with US retail options expected later this year.

latest.title: Bitcoin Dips Below $83K as Oil Shock Rattles Markets: What Happens Next?
latest.description: Bitcoin fell sharply as oil topped $101 and the 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2002. The daily chart still leans bullish. The four-hour chart disagrees.

latest.title: Gate bets all-in-one money app is crypto’s biggest consumer trend this year and next
latest.description: Gate rebrands around Gate Money, which combines accounts, asset conversion, savings and card payments as the exchange broadens beyond its trading base.

latest.title: Bitcoin price drops to $82.7K October low as bond sell-off resumes on Iran nerves
latest.description: Bitcoin fell below $83,000 to reach month-to-date lows as stocks reversed after all-time highs and bond yields spiked higher.
